[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Hugh was born in 1752. He was the son of [[Glasgow-1929|Hugh Glasgow]] and [[McCachen-1|Margaret McCachen]]. He passed away in 1831.
== Research Notes ==
=== Current paternal evidence ===
The father relationship to [[Glasgow-1929]] is assessed at 90% (confident). Hugh's Kilmarnock baptism of 1752 names Hugh Glasgow and Margaret Mcgechen (https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/60143/records/24646105); the previous 61% rested on a FamilySearch sources page without literal parents. Hugh [[Glasgow-1929]], the Kilmarnock glover who married Margaret McEachin in 1732, has the same couple's children Margaret 1738 (https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/60143/records/25993043), Hugh 1742 (https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/60143/records/26465540) and Ann 1749 (https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/60143/records/11853749), attached at 96-99%. The mother's surname, spelled McGechen, McGeachen and McEachen across the series, separates this household from the Hugh and Margaret Giffen entry of 1744 ([[Mary-4108]]). Raised from 61% to 90%.

A second Hugh born ten years after Hugh-4104 (1742) implies the first died young; no burial is held. The father's own childhood identity (Hugh-1929 as the 1710 Kilwinning child) is a separate link and unchanged. The Ancestry rows are Ancestry's copy of the FamilySearch Scotland Births and Baptisms index, not counted twice where already cited. Index transcripts only; original registers uninspected.
